name: pgarciapg-plugins
description: Pablo's collection of Claude Code plugins including design tools and notifications

plugins.name: design-team
plugins.description: A multi-agent design department for Claude Code: UX, visual, copy, accessibility, tokens, and implementation

plugins.name: domain-scout
plugins.description: AI-powered domain name finder that analyzes your codebase, generates creative name suggestions, and searches registrars for availability and pricing

plugins.name: mvp-builder
plugins.description: End-to-end MVP builder for client projects using Next.js 16, Supabase, Tailwind v4, and Vercel. Includes kickoff, scaffolding, database management, deployment workflows, AI integration, and design-first prototyping.

plugins.name: hackathon
plugins.description: Run competitive multi-team hackathons with parallel agents racing to build features. Design teams, assign agents with zero file conflicts, and let them build in parallel.

plugins.name: exec-assistant
plugins.description: Autonomous executive assistant that scans your projects daily, sends Slack briefs, and runs overnight workers to fix bugs, add tests, and open PRs while you sleep

plugins.name: mg-agent
plugins.description: MediaGarcia agent runbooks for HubSpot Projects: scout, plan, execute workstreams, collect proof, and propose HubSpot updates

plugins.name: codex-tools
plugins.description: OpenAI Codex integration for PR review and implementation plan review from within Claude Code

plugins.name: mg-utils
plugins.description: Shared Media Garcia utility commands — session reflection, handoff notes, and team conventions

plugins.name: whiteboard
plugins.description: Generate a single self-contained HTML whiteboard that visually recaps the current work — Mermaid diagrams + tables + a where-we-are header — and opens it in the browser.

plugins.name: teach-session
plugins.description: A rigorous tutor skill that verifies you deeply understand a coding session, PR, or concept — restate-first, drill-the-why, quiz with AskUserQuestion, and a color-coded HTML mastery checklist. Great for onboarding and for understanding agent-written code before you ship it.
